subject: prd/parallel-memory
statement: Limit the independence claim to disjoint code units, claim families, and finding addresses; preserve coordination on shared semantics.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: The two approved designs do not change code-unit granularity, exclusive claim ownership, record immutability, or same-address debt authority. Distinct filenames alone do not prove semantic independence.
fit_criterion: The real-Git harness must cover ten disjoint branches and 90 pair/order merges, while competing family, moved-head, code-anchor, record-byte, and same-address cases remain visible or refused.
